picks.name: Bergsonist
picks.bio: Selwa Abd's Bergsonist project, already in your library. "Depths" (May 1, 2026) is her sixth LP -- a genre-bending 12-track album of atmospheric and rhythmic excursions on Dark Entries, continuing her project of postcolonial and ancestral reconnection through sound.
picks.why_listen: Denser and more rhythmically driven than a lot of her earlier work -- good for pulling a set into stranger, more percussive territory without losing momentum.

picks.name: Session Victim
picks.source_note: Funk/breakbeat house in similar territory to Alex Nut and Carlos Niño & Friends (already featured); new label discovery (Rhythm Section International).
picks.bio: The Berlin duo's 40th EP. "The Disconnect" (July 3, 2026) is a five-track release on Rhythm Section International featuring Kenneth Scott, Rossano Snel and Quarion, following up their triple-album "Sidequests" trilogy.
picks.why_listen: Precise, characterful house built on funk elements -- breakbeats, bass guitar, rhodes, mellow synths -- a reliable mid-set groove-setter.

picks.name: Patrick Belaga
picks.bio: New York-based composer, cellist and multi-instrumentalist. "Solar Calf" (July 31, 2026) is his second solo album on PAN, using video-game-music vernacular to build a playable-feeling sonic environment rather than a linear beginning-to-end record.
picks.why_listen: Not a club tool -- a headphones-first, texturally rich listen in the same vein as your Max Cooper/Jack Sheen picks, worth knowing for intros, transitions, or off-the-clock listening.
